case_title: BELLACHS LEATHER FOR LIVING VS DODSON ROBERT L

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $500.00 FILED BY BELLACHS LEATHER FOR LIVING AS TO DEFENDANT DODSON ROBERT L ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-03-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT DODSON ROBERT L

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BELLACHS LEATHER FOR LIVING IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT DODSON ROBERT L PLTF RECOVER NOTHING STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
